blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The digital economy contributed 9.8% to the Philippine economy in 2025, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), highlighting the growing role of digital technologies in the country’s economic activity. For micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), digitalization offers opportunities to reach more customers, sell products online and make business transactions easier. READ: Marcos wants safer online transactions for consumers, MSMEs MSMEs account for more than 99% of businesses in the country and employ a majority of the workforce, according to the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI).
